title: A complete ultrametric on von Neumann's incomplete tensor products
summary: We revisit von Neumann's theory of infinite tensor products of Hilbert spaces. On the set $Γ$ of equivalence classes of $C_0$-sequences, which labels the incomplete tensor products inside the complete tensor product, we introduce a natural pseudo-ultrametric $d$: the distance between two classes is the convergence exponent of the series $\sum_j|\langle\varphi_j,ψ_j\rangle-1|$ formed from any pair of representatives.
